tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, elevated leukocytes, and presence of bacteria. Hematuria is also noted. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts are present, suggesting infection is likely limited to the lower urinary tract. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
